PZZ700-032115-
1236 AM PST Tue Nov 3 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 12 AM, a 1022 mb high was 600 miles southwest of San Diego and
a 1003 mb low was 300 miles west of Cape Mendocino. Weak offshore
flow in the mornings will alternate with afternoon onshore flow 
through Saturday. Gusty northwest winds will increase this 
afternoon and continue into Wednesday morning, with gusts of 20 
to 25 kt in the outer coastal waters. A Small Craft Advisory is 
in effect for the outer coastal waters through this period. 

$$
